---
title: Quick Start
icon: Rocket
description: Decompile your first file or unpack your first bundle.
---

Wakaru turns minified and bundled JavaScript into readable code.
Run it without a global install:

```bash
# decompile a single file
npx wakaru input.js -o output.js

# unpack a bundle into individual modules
npx wakaru bundle.js --unpack -o out/
```

The first command writes readable JavaScript to `output.js`. The second
writes recovered modules to `out/`. Use a new or empty output directory.

Open the output in your editor and search for a function, message, or URL
you recognize. [Read an unpacked bundle](/guides/read-an-unpacked-bundle)
walks through a small example.

## Install

For regular use, install the CLI globally:

```bash
npm install -g wakaru@latest
wakaru --version
```

Prebuilt binaries for macOS, Linux, and Windows are on
[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/pionxzh/wakaru/releases).

## Try it in the browser

[Try it in the playground](https://wakarujs.com/playground/) with your own
code or a built-in example. Everything runs in your browser.
See the [Playground guide](/guides/playground) for the available modes.
